Turns **your own** Bryce 3D CD (1997, Windows edition) into a Mac app for Apple Silicon. Nothing from Bryce is included: you need your CD (or an image of it) and your serial number.

**Install**

1. Download **Bryce-3D-Installer.dmg** below and open it.
2. Open **Bryce 3D Installer** from the disk that appears.
   The first time, macOS may say it can't verify the app: click **Done**, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, and click **Open Anyway** next to "Bryce 3D Installer".
3. Choose your CD image (or drag it onto the installer) and follow the steps. Bryce asks for your name and serial once.

Needs macOS 14 or later, an internet connection (the Wine engine is downloaded, about 200 MB) and about 3 GB of free space. Full instructions: see the README.
